text: Or, windowes broad within and narrow without: or, skewed and closed.
Or, vpon, or ioyning to. , Heb. floores , Heb. ribs.
Or, the vault beams and the sielings with Cedar.
Or, from the floore of the house vnto the walles, &c. And so ver. 16.
Or, gourds. , Heb. openings of flowres.
Or, oylie. Heb. trees of oyle.
Exod.25. 20. , Or, the Cherubims stretched foorth their wings.
Or, leaues of the doores. , Hebr. openings of flowers.
Or, with all the appurtenances therof, and with all the ordinances therof.
